name: Google Cedar Rapids data center campus (Big Cedar Industrial Center)
summary: Google's second Iowa data center campus, under construction at Alliant Energy's Big Cedar Industrial Center in Cedar Rapids, Linn County, where QTS has also announced a data center. Google confirmed the campus in May 2025 alongside a $7 billion two-year Iowa investment that also funds expansion in Council Bluffs; Google has not said how much goes to Cedar Rapids. Trade reporting said the first building would be finished in 2026, with four more planned and over 1,200 construction workers. Epoch AI, using satellite imagery and permit data, projects three buildings with about 261 MW of IT power and a capital cost near $9.9 billion by Q2 2027; these are analyst projections, not company figures.

location.note: OpenStreetMap point for the Big Cedar Industrial Center in Cedar Rapids, which the site owner names as the campus location; the Google parcel within the industrial center is not pinpointed.
